basic_info.description: Wake up to breathtaking panoramic ocean views and the iconic silhouettes of the Marin Headlands, Farallon Islands, Golden Gate Park, Golden Gate Bridge, and Twin Peaks from this meticulously renovated, east-facing San Francisco home. Step out onto the stunning steel-reinforced cantilever deck with Trex flooring and a glass surround, the perfect vantage point for enjoying both your expansive western panorama and breathtaking sunsets. Inside, discover three beautifully remodeled bathrooms featuring designer fixtures from Kohler, Robern, and Duravit. Culinary enthusiasts will adore the modern kitchen equipped with top-of-the-line Gaggenau appliances and custom features. Enjoy the comfort of new engineered hardwood floors throughout, enhanced by sound-diffusing QuietRock walls for ultimate tranquility. With upgraded lighting, new doors, fresh paint inside and out, and even a new mailbox, this residence offers a truly turn-key experience. Step outside to a landscaped backyard with path lighting and built-in seating, ideal for outdoor relaxation. Located just a few blocks from the new oceanfront Sunset Dunes park and walkable to local restaurants, the Outer Sunset Farmer's Market, and transportation options, this exceptional home presents an unparalleled San Francisco lifestyle.
